name: Baronet Gwendolen
source:
Baronet Gwendolen is responsible for the village of Middle Ridge and her estate north of Toowoomba in the Koor Province. Stewards manage the day-to-day running of her estates. Gwendolen is given duties to perform by her mother [url=https://vndb.org/c165739]Baroness Cynthia[/url] even though the Baroness is under the Earl of Keeping Wood. Cynthia brokered a deal between the two Earldoms to place Gwendolen under her leadership after the tragic death of Gwendolen's husband.
